previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: A woman with a history of morbid obesity, obstructive sleep apnea, COPD, diastolic heart failure, and diabetes was admitted with acute respiratory distress and generalized weakness. She was initially intubated due to inability to protect her airway and treated in the ICU for hypercarbic respiratory failure, sepsis from Klebsiella pneumonia, acute kidney injury, and acute on chronic heart failure. She was weaned off the ventilator, extubated, and transferred to the medical floor. Her infections resolved with antibiotics, fluid status improved with diuresis, and kidney function normalized. Despite recommendations, she refused rehabilitation and certain respiratory supports. Goals of care were discussed, and she agreed to palliative care follow-up at home. She was discharged to home with services on optimized medical therapy.

Discharge Instructions:
Dear Ms. ___,

You were admitted to the medical ICU through the emergency 
department for respiratory failure which required intubation.  
We suspect that this was mostly due to an exacerbation of 
congestive heart failure caused by your discontinuation of lasix 
two weeks ago.  You also had a pneumonia for which you completed 
a course of antibiotics while you were in the hospital.

To prevent this from happening again, you absolutely must take 
lasix regularly.  If for some reason you are unable to do so, 
you should discuss it promptly with your physicians.  When you 
do not take lasix, fluid accumulates in your legs and lungs.

During this admission we removed approximately 20 liter ___ 
gallons) of fluid from your body.

It is very important that you not smoke while using oxygen at 
home--this could lead to a lethal explosion and is dangerous not 
only for you, but also the people around you.

Medication changes:::
-Continue on lasix 40 po QD-please take everyday 
-discontinue provigil and triazolam
-start fluticasone 110 INH BID
-stop sybicort
-cont spiriva, stop trospium
-pantoprazole 20 po QD and discontinue omeprazole 20 po QD
-take half of your normal dose of imdur-please take 60 mg po QD 
(old dose was 120 po QD)
-metoprolol 25 po BID
